name: spinning-text
title: Spinning Text
description: A string of small text laid out around a circle with dot separators, rotating continuously so the whole ring of words travels around the centre.
use: A badge, stamp or hero accent should show a rotating circular caption.
avoid: Long sentences; small curved letters are hard to read while the ring spins.
a11y: A screen-reader-only copy gives the full text, but the endless spin never checks reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A thin ring of small white letters on black, each character angled to follow the circle. Round dots separate the phrases, and the letters are tightly and evenly spaced around the empty centre.
behaves: The entire ring rotates at a constant speed in one direction, so each word sweeps past the top and around again. It never stops or changes pace.
customise: Pass the text as a string or array and set radius, duration, reverse, transition or custom variants; the letter spacing derives from the character count.
weight: light: One rotating container with a span per character; no per-frame script.
